primitives.name: Quantity Modification Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Quantities of any items in your shopping cart. If you don't press it, your changes won't
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'Q_i': 'quantity of item i (dimensionless)', 'D_i': 'deletion flag for item i (boolean)'}
primitives.assumptions: Quantities are integers; deletion occurs when Q_i = 0.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When Q_i < 0, undefined behavior; when Q_i = 0, D_i = true.

layer2.mapping: Operator modifies item vector Q = [Q_1,...,Q_n]; deletion corresponds to projection onto subspace where Q_i = 0.
layer2.telemetry: Number of deleted items per session
